title: ChartM3: A Multi-Stage Code-Driven Pipeline for Constructing Multi-Dimensional and Multi-Step Visual Reasoning Data in Chart Comprehension
authors_zh: Duo Xu、Hao Cheng、Xin Lin、Zhen Xie、Hao Henry Wang
paper_type_zh: 图表推理数据构建与验证配方
best_for_zh: 关注可执行多模态数据生成、图表推理 SFT/RLVR 及奖励边界审计的研究者
one_line: ChartM3 reports a code-driven pipeline for 141,800 training and 2,871 test Q&A, but execution checks, learned judges, privileged code-output rationales, and unreconciled retained-versus-final counts remain unauditable without an official release.
ChartM3 报告以数据、渲染和分析代码驱动的图表推理构造流程，但未发布可核验的官方语料，执行、学习型 judge 与代码输出型推理仍须分开审计。
why: It shows how to preserve chart/data/code/question lineage for multimodal SFT and final-answer RLVR, while demonstrating that executable construction and downstream gains do not mechanically certify chart visibility, reasoning faithfulness, learned-judge correctness, or record-level provenance.
inclusion_reason: ChartM3 gives a detailed code-driven blueprint linking chart templates, data/rendering/analysis programs, pixels, rationales, mixed quality controls, and final-answer RL rewards, even though the claimed corpus is not officially released.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Chart-reasoning data must keep five views mutually consistent: the chart pixels, underlying table, analytical computation, question, and final answer. A Python program can execute successfully while the chart remains occluded or misleading; a calculation can be correct over source data while depending on values that a vision-only solver cannot read. Natural-language rationales add another boundary because fluent steps may be written after the numerical result is already known.

ChartM3 addresses this construction problem with a staged pipeline that produces data code, rendering code, chart images, analysis code, multi-step explanations, and answers, followed by execution, learned-model, and human checks. It reports both SFT and RLVR uses. The feedback contract is therefore mixed rather than fully programmatic, and no author-confirmed code or dataset artifact was verified. This Card treats the paper as a detailed construction blueprint, not as an independently inspectable release.

图表推理数据必须让五种视图保持一致：图表像素、底层表格、分析计算、问题和最终答案。Python 程序可以成功执行，但图表仍可能存在遮挡或误导；基于源数据的计算可以正确，却依赖纯视觉解题者无法读出的数值。自然语言 rationale 又增加一层边界，因为数值结果已经确定后仍可补写出流畅步骤。

ChartM3 用分阶段流水线处理这一构造问题，依次产生数据代码、渲染代码、图表图像、分析代码、多步 explanation 和答案，再经过执行、学习型模型及人工检查。论文同时报告 SFT 与 RLVR 用途。因此其反馈契约是混合式而非完全程序化；本卡也未核验到作者确认的代码或数据产物。这里将论文视为详细的构造蓝图，而不是可独立检查的开放发布。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The intended data object preserves a long construction lineage: scenario and key question; retrieved chart template and attributes; contextual narrative; generated data code and CSV; visualization analysis; preprocessing/rendering code; chart image; task/question type and options; executable analytical code and output; step-by-step explanation; final answer; quality decisions; and difficulty score. The paper covers 60 visualization domains, 9 major and 62 minor statistical chart types, and 18 Q&A categories across visual recognition, data extraction, calculation, and data analysis, plus Chart-to-Markdown.

Table 2 reports 132,955 single-chart and 8,845 multi-chart training questions—141,800 exactly—and 2,271 plus 600 test questions—2,871 exactly. It lists 31,772/6,650 training charts and 1,221/333 test charts for the two subsets; the abstract rounds training scale to 38K charts and 142K Q&A. Average reasoning lengths are 202.40/266.43 tokens for single-/multi-chart training items and 236.03/274.88 for test items, measured with the Qwen2.5 tokenizer.

The construction trace and training targets are not identical. CoT-SFT consumes question, image, explanation, and answer records. The 30K GRPO subset consumes questions and final answers, while the paper explicitly excludes the supplied CoT path from the RL signal. A row-level schema, file inventory, hashes, and exact mapping from the generated lineage to SFT/RL/test records remain unknown because no official corpus was verified.

目标数据对象保留一条较长的构造 lineage：场景与 key question；检索得到的图表模板及属性；上下文叙事；生成的数据代码与 CSV；可视化分析；预处理/渲染代码；图表图像；任务/问题类型与选项；可执行分析代码及输出；逐步 explanation；最终答案；质量判定和难度分数。论文覆盖 60 个可视化领域、9 个大类和 62 个子类的统计图表，以及视觉识别、数据提取、计算和数据分析四个维度下的 18 类问答，另含 Chart-to-Markdown。

表 2 报告 132,955 条单图训练问题和 8,845 条多图训练问题，精确合计 141,800；测试问题为 2,271 + 600，合计 2,871。表中还列出两类子集的训练图表数 31,772/6,650 和测试图表数 1,221/333；摘要将训练规模取整为 38K 张图表和 142K 条问答。用 Qwen2.5 tokenizer 计量时，单图/多图训练样本的平均 reasoning 长度为 202.40/266.43 token，测试样本为 236.03/274.88。

构造 trace 与训练目标并不相同。CoT-SFT 消费问题、图像、explanation 和答案记录；30K GRPO 子集只消费问题和最终答案，论文明确排除了所提供 CoT path 的 RL 信号。由于没有核验到官方语料，row-level schema、文件清单、hash，以及生成 lineage 到 SFT/RL/test 记录的准确映射均为 unknown。

title: Method
方法
html:
The reconstructable pipeline is:

  1. Build a template database. Derive a 9-major/62-minor taxonomy from Matplotlib, Vega, EChart, and Seaborn. Claude 3.5 generates structured data/code templates and recreates styles from collected finance, scientific, and other real-world charts. Templates receive domain, theme, purpose, definition, scenario, and data-characteristic tags, with manual refinement. Source URLs, per-template provenance, and rights records are unknown.
  2. Generate data and charts. Author key questions over 60 domains, then use RAG to select a representative chart type/template. An LLM writes contextual narrative and Python data-generation code containing trends, stochastic functions, controlled noise, and optional outliers; execution produces CSV rather than accepting a directly generated table. Another LLM pass analyzes visualization requirements, randomizes style guidance, and writes preprocess/plot functions. Rendering failures return code and error messages for iterative repair. Generator identities, sandbox/library versions, timeout, maximum retries, and random seeds are unknown.
  3. Generate questions, programs, rationales, and answers. Qwen2.5-VL-72B is used to formulate questions from visible chart information. For computation-heavy tasks, a two-pass prompt first generates the question and analytical Python code from chart code/source data, then executes that program. The next prompt tells the model to trust the code output, write a step-by-step explanation as if derived from the chart, and avoid mentioning code. This produces a useful executable lineage but risks rationales that depend on privileged source values rather than legible pixels.
  4. Filter and refine. Remove malformed outputs and execution failures. Train a Qwen2-VL-2B chart-quality classifier from 700 positive and 500 negative examples after correcting model prelabels. Use multimodal judges for chart relevance, data accuracy, and logical consistency. Estimate difficulty as the number of failures across ten high-temperature small-model attempts and remove overly easy items. For the benchmark, rebalance difficulty, manually verify/correct items, tune the judge prompt, and delete cases with inconsistent judgments. A roughly 5,800-item audit by Claude 3.5 with human/Claude dual checking of initially incorrect cases finds 508 requiring modification or removal and reports 91.24% instruction accuracy.
  5. Train with distinct targets. Full CoT-SFT freezes the vision encoder and trains for two epochs at learning rate 1e-5 and batch size 64. The 30K GRPO set samples difficulty 3--9 and contains 6,958 true/false, 6,734 multiple-choice, 2,657 short-answer, and 13,651 fill-in items. GRPO uses seven rollouts per prompt, a global batch of seven prompts, learning rate 1e-6, KL coefficient 0.04, k2 KL approximation, and eight A100 80GB GPUs. Binary format reward checks the required think/answer tags; answer reward is exact match for closed forms and Qwen3-32B judgment for open forms. The supplied CoT is not rewarded.

可重建的流水线如下：

  1. 构建模板数据库。 从 Matplotlib、Vega、EChart 和 Seaborn 归纳 9 个大类/62 个子类。Claude 3.5 生成结构化数据/代码模板，并根据收集到的金融、科研及其他真实图表复刻风格。模板带有领域、主题、用途、定义、场景和数据特征标签，细节再经人工修订。来源 URL、逐模板溯源和权利记录为 unknown。
  2. 生成数据与图表。 在 60 个领域中设计 key question，再通过 RAG 选择代表性图表类型/模板。LLM 编写上下文叙事与 Python 数据生成代码，其中包含趋势、随机函数、受控噪声及可选异常值；执行代码生成 CSV，而不是直接接受模型输出表格。另一轮 LLM 分析可视化需求、随机化 style guidance，并编写 preprocess/plot 函数。渲染失败时把代码与报错返回模型迭代修复。generator 身份、sandbox/库版本、超时、最大重试次数和随机种子均为 unknown。
  3. 生成问题、程序、推理与答案。 Qwen2.5-VL-72B 用于从可见图表信息生成问题。对计算密集任务，两步 prompt 先依据图表代码/源数据生成问题与分析 Python 代码，再执行程序；后一条 prompt 要求模型完全信任代码输出，把逐步 explanation 写成仿佛从图表推得，并避免提及代码。这形成了有用的可执行 lineage，也带来 rationale 依赖不可见源数值而非清晰像素的风险。
  4. 筛选与修订。 删除异常输出和执行失败；人工纠正模型预标后，用 700 个正例和 500 个负例训练 Qwen2-VL-2B 图表质量分类器；多模态 judge 检查图表相关性、数据准确性和逻辑一致性。小模型高温尝试十次，以失败次数估计难度并删除过易项。benchmark 还要重平衡难度、人工核验/修订、优化 judge prompt，并删除判定不一致样例。约 5,800 条样本先由 Claude 3.5 评估，再对初判错误项进行 Claude/人工双重检查；其中 508 条需修改或删除，报告 instruction accuracy 为 91.24%。
  5. 使用不同目标训练。 完整 CoT-SFT 冻结 vision encoder，以学习率 1e-5、batch size 64 训练两轮。30K GRPO 集从难度 3--9 抽样，含 6,958 条判断题、6,734 条选择题、2,657 条短答题和 13,651 条填空题。GRPO 每个 prompt 采样七条 rollout，全局 batch 含七个 prompt，学习率 1e-6，KL 系数 0.04，采用 k2 KL 近似，并使用 8 张 A100 80GB。二元 format reward 检查指定 think/answer 标签；闭合题型用 exact match，开放题型用 Qwen3-32B 判定答案。所提供 CoT 不进入 reward。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The formal Findings of EMNLP paper verifies five authors, Alibaba Cloud Computing, pages 13046--13068, DOI, the full pipeline, and appendix prompts. No author-confirmed repository, dataset, project page, schema, or corpus license was found as of 2026-07-21; a similarly named third-party Hugging Face dataset is not attributed here.

Table 7 provides intermediate retention evidence. Single-chart quality filtering retains 34,064 of 38,452 charts (88.59%), and Q&A filtering retains 140,312 of 171,531 items (81.80%). Multi-chart filtering retains 3,777 of 4,336 chart pairs (87.11%) and 9,821 of 11,331 Q&A (86.68%). These retained-pool counts do not reconcile with Table 2's final train+test totals: 135,226 single Q&A, 9,445 multi Q&A, and 32,993 single charts; the multi-chart units also differ. Without item IDs or an attrition ledger, the gap cannot be assigned to later filtering, unused records, or a reporting mismatch.

For Qwen2.5-VL-3B, Table 3 reports ChartM3/ChartM3-Multi accuracy rising from 45.00/34.83 to 62.88/51.67 after full CoT-SFT. In the controlled 30K comparison, Table 4 reports 58.17/47.17 for SFT and 52.40/40.33 for GRPO, versus 45.00/34.83 for the base; SFT is stronger in-domain, while GRPO reports advantages on some external reasoning benchmarks. A CoT prompt alone produces 43.68/34.83, so gains are not explained by merely requesting a rationale.

These experiments show that the paper-described training mixtures change model behavior. They do not verify every chart/rationale, resolve the retained-versus-final count gap, calibrate learned judges over the complete corpus, or establish that code-derived reasoning is recoverable from pixels. GRPO results are particularly separate from trace quality because the RL objective ignores the supplied CoT paths.

Findings of EMNLP 正式论文核实了五位作者、Alibaba Cloud Computing、13046--13068 页、DOI、完整流水线及附录 prompt。截至 2026-07-21，未找到作者确认的仓库、数据集、项目页、schema 或语料许可证；同名第三方 Hugging Face 数据集不归属于本论文。

表 7 给出中间保留证据。单图质量筛选从 38,452 张保留 34,064 张（88.59%），问答筛选从 171,531 条保留 140,312 条（81.80%）；多图筛选从 4,336 对图表保留 3,777 对（87.11%），问答从 11,331 条保留 9,821 条（86.68%）。这些保留池数量无法与表 2 的最终 train+test 总数对齐：单图问答 135,226、多图问答 9,445、单图表 32,993，多图的计量单位也不一致。没有 item ID 或 attrition ledger，无法判断差额来自后续筛选、未使用记录还是报告不一致。

表 3 报告 Qwen2.5-VL-3B 在 ChartM3/ChartM3-Multi 上从 45.00/34.83 提升到完整 CoT-SFT 后的 62.88/51.67。在受控 30K 比较中，表 4 的 SFT 为 58.17/47.17，GRPO 为 52.40/40.33，基座为 45.00/34.83；SFT 在域内更强，而 GRPO 在部分外部推理 benchmark 上有优势。仅添加 CoT prompt 时为 43.68/34.83，说明增益不能用“要求模型输出 rationale”来解释。

这些实验说明论文所述训练混合会改变模型行为，但不能核验每张图表或每条 rationale，不能解释保留池与最终计数差额，不能证明学习型 judge 在全语料上的校准，也不能证明代码衍生推理能从像素恢复。GRPO 结果尤其应与 trace 质量分开，因为 RL 目标忽略了所提供的 CoT path。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Chart templates, programmatic chart rendering, program-of-thought calculation, multimodal filtering, and RLVR each have precedents. ChartM3's distinctive contribution is the breadth and integration of an end-to-end lineage over 62 chart subtypes: a retrieved style/template conditions data-code generation, rendering code turns structured values into pixels, analytical code computes answers, and learned/human filters select records for CoT-SFT, evaluation, or final-answer GRPO.

The pipeline separates several verification roles that should not be collapsed. Program execution checks operational validity; a classifier checks chart presentation; multimodal judges check relevance, accuracy, and logic; sampled models estimate difficulty; humans refine the test set; exact match verifies closed-form RL answers; Qwen3-32B judges open-form rewards; and Qwen-Max judges benchmark predictions. This layered design is more realistic than labeling the whole corpus “programmatically verified.”

Its most revealing feature is also a trace-faithfulness risk: analysis code is executed on source data, and the rationale generator is instructed to conceal that source and narrate the result as visual reasoning. The novelty is therefore a scalable, multi-view construction recipe—not mechanical certification that every explanation reflects information available in the rendered chart.

图表模板、程序化渲染、program-of-thought 计算、多模态筛选和 RLVR 各自都有先例。ChartM3 的独特贡献在于覆盖 62 个图表子类型并整合端到端 lineage：检索的风格/模板约束数据代码生成，渲染代码把结构化数值转成像素，分析代码计算答案，学习型与人工筛选再选择记录进入 CoT-SFT、评测或最终答案 GRPO。

该流水线区分了多种不应混为一谈的验证角色。程序执行检查操作有效性；分类器检查图表呈现；多模态 judge 检查相关性、准确性和逻辑；采样模型估计难度；人工修订测试集；exact match 验证闭合式 RL 答案；Qwen3-32B 判断开放式 reward；Qwen-Max 判断 benchmark 预测。这种分层设计比把整个语料称为“程序化验证”更准确。

最值得注意的特征同时也是轨迹忠实性风险：分析代码在源数据上执行，rationale 生成器又被要求隐藏这一来源，把结果叙述成视觉推理。因此其新意是可扩展的多视图构造配方，而不是对每条 explanation 仅使用渲染图中可见信息的机械认证。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
• No inspectable release. No author-confirmed code, dataset, project page, schema, license, or immutable snapshot was verified. Generator assignments, environment/library versions, prompts beyond the appendix, seeds, retry/timeout policy, file/split IDs, and row-level provenance therefore cannot be replayed or audited. A similarly named third-party dataset is not evidence for this paper.
  • The count lineage is incomplete. Table 7 retained pools exceed Table 2 final train+test totals by 5,086 single-chart Q&A, 376 multi-chart Q&A, and 1,071 single charts; multi-chart counts also use ambiguous pair/image units. No later-stage attrition or membership ledger explains the differences.
  • Execution is not visual verification. Data, rendering, and analysis programs can run while labels overlap, values are hidden, a chart is misleading, or the question relies on non-visible source values. The paper itself reports that even 72B MLLMs miss occlusion and layout defects.
  • Rationales can use privileged information. The appendix instructs the answer generator to fully trust analysis-code output and present it as if derived from chart pixels without mentioning the code. This makes the explanation susceptible to post-hoc rationalization and visually unrecoverable calculations.
  • Learned filters have limited calibration. The Qwen2-VL-2B quality classifier uses 1,200 corrected examples and reports validation metrics on 107 instances. The approximately 5,800-item instruction audit uses Claude 3.5 first and dual Claude/human review for initially incorrect cases; it does not establish whole-corpus error rates or independent validation of initially accepted items.
  • Reward and evaluation are mixed. Qwen3-32B supplies open-answer RL rewards and Qwen-Max judges benchmarks. Exact model revisions, calibration, false-positive/negative rates, disagreement handling, prompt sensitivity, and adversarial robustness are unknown. The benchmark judge allows some expression/unit variation and a 5% numerical tolerance, whereas closed-form RL rewards use strict matching.
  • RL does not validate CoT. GRPO excludes the constructed CoT paths; any required think block receives format reward based on syntax. The 30K set's rule/model reward counts are 13,692/16,308, only approximately balanced. RL gains support final-answer optimization under this reward, not explanation correctness.
  • Split and contamination controls are unknown. No immutable split rule, template/source-family grouping, near-duplicate check, or overlap audit is reported for source charts, recreated styles, few-shot examples, prompts, ChartQA, ReachQA, CharXiv, or other evaluation sets.
  • Human and rights audits are incomplete. The paper reports consent, privacy, compensation, anonymization, and manual benchmark correction, but not annotator counts, qualifications, instructions, agreement, or item-level edits. It states that artifact licenses were respected but publishes no source URLs or rights manifest for collected charts, recreated styles, templates, generated images/code, or redistribution.
  • Scope is narrow. Rendering is primarily Python-based and focuses on statistical charts; flowcharts, relational diagrams, other visualization languages, and larger model/data-scale RL are explicitly left for future work.

• 没有可检查的发布。 本卡未核验到作者确认的代码、数据集、项目页、schema、license 或不可变快照。各阶段 generator 分工、环境/库版本、附录以外 prompt、seed、重试/超时策略、文件/split ID 和逐条溯源均无法回放审计。同名第三方数据集不能作为本论文的证据。
  • 计数 lineage 不完整。 表 7 的保留池比表 2 最终 train+test 多出 5,086 条单图问答、376 条多图问答和 1,071 张单图表；多图计数还混用了图对/图像单位。没有后续 attrition 或成员台账解释差额。
  • 执行不等于视觉验证。 数据、渲染和分析程序即使能运行，也可能出现标签重叠、数值不可见、图表误导，或问题依赖不可见源数据。论文本身也指出，72B MLLM 仍会漏检遮挡与布局缺陷。
  • Rationale 可能使用特权信息。 附录要求答案生成器完全信任分析代码输出，并在不提代码的情况下把它写成由图表像素推得。这会导致事后合理化和视觉上无法复现的计算。
  • 学习型筛选校准有限。 Qwen2-VL-2B 质量分类器使用 1,200 条人工纠正样本，只在 107 条验证样本上报告指标。约 5,800 条 instruction 审计先由 Claude 3.5 判断，只对初判错误项做 Claude/人工双重检查；它不能给出全语料误差率，也不能独立验证初判通过项。
  • Reward 与评测是混合契约。 Qwen3-32B 提供开放答案 RL reward，Qwen-Max 判断 benchmark。准确模型 revision、校准、假阳性/假阴性、分歧处理、prompt 敏感性和对抗稳健性均为 unknown。benchmark judge 接受部分表达/单位变化与 5% 数值误差，而闭合题型 RL reward 使用 strict match。
  • RL 不能验证 CoT。 GRPO 排除构造的 CoT path；所需 think block 只按语法获得 format reward。30K 集的规则/模型 reward 数量为 13,692/16,308，只是近似平衡。RL 增益支持该 reward 下的最终答案优化，不支持 explanation 正确性。
  • Split 与污染控制未知。 论文没有给出不可变 split 规则、模板/来源族分组、近重复检查，也没有审计源图表、复刻风格、few-shot 示例、prompt、ChartQA、ReachQA、CharXiv 或其他评测集的重叠。
  • 人工与权利审计不完整。 论文说明了同意、隐私、补偿、匿名化和人工 benchmark 修订，但没有给出标注人数、资质、说明、agreement 或逐条修改。论文称遵守所用 artifact 的 license，却没有发布收集图表、复刻风格、模板、生成图像/代码或再分发的来源 URL 与权利清单。
  • 覆盖范围有限。 渲染主要基于 Python 并聚焦统计图表；流程图、关系图、其他可视化语言及更大模型/数据规模的 RL 被明确留作未来工作。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
Within data_construction_open_release_recipes, ChartM3 is a strong specification for preserving chart/data/code/question lineage rather than shipping image-question-answer triples alone. A reusable record should keep the template and source revision, scenario/key question, generated CSV and data code, visualization analysis, renderer and environment versions, chart-image hash, analytical code/output, explanation, answer, every execution/filter/judge result, difficulty trials, human edits, split membership, and license provenance.

The paper is also useful for designing explicit feedback boundaries. Execution logs, visual-quality classification, multimodal consistency judgments, human adjudication, rule rewards, model rewards, and benchmark evaluation should be separate fields with pinned model/prompt versions. For pixel-grounded supervision, builders should add a visibility test that proves every value needed by the question and rationale can be recovered from the rendered chart, rather than trusting source-data code output.

The recipe can inform chart-reasoning SFT, program-supported multimodal synthesis, difficulty-aware RLVR sampling, mixed-verifier datasets, and benchmark construction. A production release should version SFT and RL subsets separately because SFT consumes explanations while the reported RL objective consumes final answers. Downstream gains motivate reuse of the design; they do not replace record-level execution, visibility, contamination, judge, rights, and split audits.

在 data_construction_open_release_recipes 轨道中，ChartM3 是一个值得参考的图表/data/code/question lineage 规格，而不是只发布图像—问题—答案三元组。可复用记录应保存模板与来源 revision、场景/key question、生成 CSV 与数据代码、可视化分析、renderer 与环境版本、图表图像 hash、分析代码/输出、explanation、答案、每次执行/filter/judge 结果、难度试验、人工修改、split 成员和许可证溯源。

论文也有助于设计清晰的反馈边界。执行日志、视觉质量分类、多模态一致性判断、人工仲裁、规则 reward、模型 reward 和 benchmark 评测应拆成不同字段，并固定模型/prompt 版本。若要得到像素扎根监督，还应增加可见性测试，证明问题和 rationale 所需的每个数值都能从渲染图恢复，而不是直接信任源数据上的代码输出。

该配方可用于图表推理 SFT、程序辅助的多模态合成、难度感知 RLVR 抽样、混合验证器数据集及 benchmark 构造。生产级发布应分别版本化 SFT 与 RL 子集，因为 SFT 消费 explanation，而论文所述 RL 目标只消费最终答案。下游增益支持复用这一设计，却不能替代逐条执行、可见性、污染、judge、权利和 split 审计。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Read §3 with Appendix A.7. The prompts reveal that questions and analysis programs use source data/chart code, then rationales are instructed to hide code dependence and appear visually derived.
  • Keep reported units exact: 141,800 training Q&A and 2,871 test Q&A; the abstract's 142K Q&A and 38K training charts are rounded. Compare Table 7 retained pools with Table 2 final splits—the unexplained differences are an audit question, not evidence for additional released data.
  • Separate the contracts: program execution, Qwen2-VL-2B chart classification, multimodal consistency judging, ten-sample difficulty estimation, human test refinement, exact-match RL reward, Qwen3-32B open-answer reward, and Qwen-Max benchmark judgment.
  • Read Tables 3 and 4 together. Full CoT-SFT gives 62.88/51.67 on ChartM3/ChartM3-Multi; in the 30K comparison SFT gives 58.17/47.17 and GRPO 52.40/40.33. GRPO's value is not uniformly higher in-domain.
  • Remember that GRPO ignores the supplied CoT paths. Its seven rollouts and binary think/answer format reward cannot certify explanation quality.
  • Do not attach the similarly named third-party Hugging Face dataset. Preserve code/data/project/license as unavailable until an author-confirmed artifact appears.

• 将 §3 与附录 A.7 一起读。Prompt 表明问题与分析程序使用源数据/图表代码，随后又要求 rationale 隐藏代码依赖并表现为视觉推导。
  • 保持报告单位精确：141,800 条训练问答、2,871 条测试问答；摘要中的 142K 条问答和 38K 张训练图表是取整数。还应对照表 7 的保留池与表 2 的最终 split；无法解释的差额是审计问题，不是额外发布数据的证据。
  • 分开理解各项契约：程序执行、Qwen2-VL-2B 图表分类、多模态一致性 judge、十次采样难度估计、人工测试集修订、exact-match RL reward、Qwen3-32B 开放答案 reward 和 Qwen-Max benchmark 判断。
  • 联读表 3 与表 4。完整 CoT-SFT 在 ChartM3/ChartM3-Multi 上为 62.88/51.67；30K 对比中的 SFT 为 58.17/47.17，GRPO 为 52.40/40.33。GRPO 在域内并非始终更强。
  • 记住 GRPO 忽略所提供的 CoT path。七条 rollout 和二元 think/answer format reward 都不能认证 explanation 质量。
  • 不要关联同名第三方 Hugging Face 数据集。在出现作者确认产物前，code/data/project/license 都应保持不可用。

value.html: Scenario-level key questions are authored across 60 data-visualization domains, then matched by RAG to professional chart templates spanning 9 major and 62 minor chart types. The template database is derived from chart taxonomies, manually refined generated templates, and styles recreated from collected real-world charts.

A paper-described lineage can contain chart-template tags, contextual narrative, generated data code and CSV, visualization requirements, preprocessing/rendering code, chart image, task and question type, question/options, executable analysis code/output, step-by-step explanation, final answer, quality decisions, and difficulty. Released row schema is unknown because no author-confirmed data artifact was verified.

Claude 3.5 generates structured data/code templates for the template database and recreates real-chart styles. Qwen2.5-VL-72B is disclosed for visually grounded question generation. LLMs generate data code, visualization analysis, rendering code, analysis code, rationales, and answers, but the model/checkpoint assignment for every stage is unknown.

An executable, primarily Python-based generation environment over 62 statistical chart subtypes. Data code writes CSV; visualization code renders chart images; analytical code computes intermediate and final results. Failed rendering code is iteratively repaired with its error message. Exact library versions, sandbox, timeout, seeds, retry cap, and execution-isolation policy are unknown.

Construction uses execution filtering, a Qwen2-VL-2B chart-quality classifier, multimodal judges for chart relevance, data accuracy, and logical consistency, sampled-model difficulty, and manual benchmark correction. GRPO uses a binary format reward plus answer accuracy: strict matching for multiple-choice/true-false and Qwen3-32B binary judgment for fill-in-the-blank/short answers. Qwen-Max judges reported benchmark predictions. These are distinct contracts.

A construction item survives code execution and learned/human filters; exact per-stage conjunction and thresholds are not fully specified. In GRPO, the final response must use the required think/answer tags and receive either exact-match or Qwen3-32B answer credit. The synthesized CoT path is not an RL reward input.

Qwen2.5-VL-3B is the base in the 30K SFT-versus-GRPO comparison and in the full-data Qwen2.5-VL CoT-SFT result; LLaVA-OneVision-7B is also tested with full-data CoT-SFT. The paper's generic phrase Qwen2.5-VL should not be read as one model size for every experiment.

Claude 3.5 is named for template/code creation and style recreation; Qwen2.5-VL-72B is named for chart-visible question generation. Qwen2-VL-2B is a trained filter, Qwen3-32B is an RL judge, and Qwen-Max is an evaluation judge. Complete generator assignments, model revisions, prompts outside the appendix, and sampling settings are unknown.

Build a multi-attribute template database; generate scenario-conditioned data code with distributions, trends, and noise; execute it to obtain structured data; generate visualization analysis and rendering code with a retrieved template/few-shot example; execute and repair the renderer; synthesize questions and analytical code; execute the analysis; then generate a rationale and answer from the code output before multi-model filtering and benchmark refinement.

Domain/key question -> RAG chart template -> contextual data-generation code -> CSV -> visualization analysis and code -> executed chart -> question plus analytical code -> code execution -> rationale/answer -> quality and difficulty filters. GRPO uniformly samples 30,000 questions from difficulty scores 3--9 and samples seven rollouts per prompt.

Remove abnormal generations and execution failures; iteratively repair failed rendering code; apply a Qwen2-VL-2B chart-quality classifier; judge visual relevance, data accuracy, and logic; estimate difficulty from ten high-temperature model attempts and remove overly easy questions; retain GRPO items with difficulty 3--9; manually verify/correct the test set and remove items with inconsistent judge decisions. Exact thresholds, repair limits, full prompts/models, stage yields by model, and item-level decisions are unknown.

Ten high-temperature attempts per item for difficulty estimation and seven GRPO rollouts per prompt. Exact difficulty-model identities, temperatures, token limits, retry budgets, and construction candidate counts are unknown.

Full-data and 30K SFT experiments freeze the vision encoder and train two epochs at learning rate 1e-5 with batch size 64. GRPO uses learning rate 1e-6, KL coefficient 0.04, the k2 KL approximation, seven rollouts per prompt, and a global batch of seven prompts. Training uses eight NVIDIA A100 80GB GPUs. Optimizer, scheduler, warmup, precision, gradient settings, seeds, and checkpoints are unknown.

Table 2 reports 132,955 single-chart plus 8,845 multi-chart training questions (141,800 exact total) and 2,271 plus 600 test questions (2,871 total). It lists 31,772/6,650 training charts and 1,221/333 test charts for the two subsets. The abstract rounds training scale to 38K charts and 142K Q&A. No author-confirmed files were available to recount.

Paper-reported train/test counts only. Table 7 retained-pool counts do not reconcile to Table 2 final splits: single Q&A 140,312 versus 135,226 final train+test; multi Q&A 9,821 versus 9,445; single charts 34,064 versus 32,993; and the multi-chart units also differ. No attrition ledger, immutable item IDs, split rule, seed, or released split files explain the remainder.

unknown; the paper provides no overlap ledger for retrieved/recreated templates, source charts, few-shot examples, generated prompts/images, or ChartQA/ReachQA/CharXiv and other evaluation benchmarks.

items: Executable data/rendering/analysis code proves that programs run, not that chart pixels expose every referenced value, remain legible, or uniquely support the answer.

The rationale prompt says to fully trust analytical code output and present it as if calculated from chart pixels without mentioning code. This can create privileged-data or post-hoc traces that a vision-only solver could not reproduce.
Even 72B MLLMs reportedly miss occlusion/layout defects. The Qwen2-VL-2B classifier is validated on only 107 instances; learned visual filters may inherit generator/style blind spots.

The reported 91.24% instruction accuracy comes from about 5,800 sampled items: Claude 3.5 judged them, while dual Claude/human verification focused on initially incorrect cases. It is not a corpus-wide independent audit.

Qwen3-32B short-answer reward and Qwen-Max benchmark evaluation are learned judgments, not programmatic correctness proofs; prompt, model version, calibration, disagreement, and adversarial robustness are incomplete.

GRPO explicitly omits the supplied CoT paths and optimizes questions/final answers, so RL gains cannot validate the rationale corpus. A compliant think block receives format credit regardless of faithfulness.

The 30K GRPO set contains 6,958 true/false, 6,734 multiple-choice, 2,657 short-answer, and 13,651 fill-in items. The stated approximately 1:1 rule/model reward balance is 13,692 versus 16,308, not an exact balance.
Table 7 retained-pool totals and Table 2 final split totals leave unexplained attrition, and no record IDs or selection ledger are available to audit which items moved into SFT, RL, or test subsets.
Test-set manual verification/correction is reported, but annotator count, qualifications, instructions, agreement, exact corrections, and per-item adjudication are not released.
Collected real-world charts and recreated styles introduce provenance, copyright, and source-contamination risks; only a general license-compliance statement is provided.
The paper reports only statistical charts generated primarily in Python; flowcharts, relational diagrams, other visualization languages, and larger-scale RL are explicitly outside the current scope.

No author-confirmed repository, dataset, project page, schema, immutable snapshot, or generated-corpus license was verified. A similarly named third-party Hugging Face dataset is deliberately not attributed to this paper.
